name: Wheeling (United States)
description: Two horizontal dark blue bars for Wheeling Creek and the Ohio River with a white bar between them bearing five gold stars.
history: Wheeling is a city in Ohio and Marshall counties, West Virginia. The flag was adopted on 4 September 2018 for the celebration of the city's 250th anniversary, replacing the banner adopted in 1968; its blue bars represent Wheeling Creek and the Ohio River. In a 2022 survey by the North American Vexillological Association it was ranked the seventh best American city flag.
